source_policy.summary: Official school closure announcements are added only from Bernama reports. Every entry links to the Bernama article it comes from.

closures.dates_note: Five more days starting Monday 19 October, which ends on Friday 23 October. Reopening is reviewed before then.
closures.covers: All schools and educational institutions throughout Johor.
closures.not_covered: Private educational institutions and childcare centres decide for themselves whether to open; those that open must operate indoors with face masks.
closures.exceptions: Limited exemptions may be considered for students sitting exams or assessments, coordinated with the Johor State Education Department (JPNJ).
closures.announced_by: Dr Muhammad Naqib Md Ghazali, Johor Education and Information Committee chairman, after a meeting of the Johor Haze Management Coordination Committee
closures.previous: Extends the closure of all Johor schools from 12 to 16 October.

sources.title: Haze: Schools, educational institutions in Johor to close for another five days from Monday
Jerebu: Sekolah, institusi pendidikan Johor ditutup lima hari lagi bermula Isnin
